Sophie: Hey team, my corpcard got a soft-decline for a EuroCity ticket this AM. I had to buy same-day on my personal card to not miss meetings. Receipt + decline screenshot attached. Do I submit as reimbursement or can travel reassign the charge to the corpcard?

Tom (Finance): Sorry for the hiccup. Submit as reimbursement and tag your manager for retro approval. If travel can re-bill the corpcard we can void the reimbursement, but we rarely swap charges after the fact.

Sophie: Cool. Filing now. Any particular expense category?

Erin (Travel): If it was booked via Travel team originally, say "Travel - Rail (Booked by Travel)" and note original PNR. That helps reconcile with vendor.

Sophie: Adding PNR 7Y6-44 and uploading files: https://files.redwood.example/receipts/2000056789-rail.pdf Screenshot: attached.

Laura: I approve retro for this one, sounds policy-compliant (corpcard failure + critical trip). Tagging @Tom (Finance) for final sign-off.

Tom (Finance): Thanks @Laura. Expense submitted as EXP-3972. We'll process reimbursement via payroll unless you pick bank transfer. Note: EU rail VAT usually non-reclaimable, so no VAT recovery expected. :thumbsup:

ExpenseBot: EXP-3972 received. Status: pending finance review. ETA 2-3 business days.

Sophie: Thanks all. Erin, if travel can confirm whether vendor accepted the corpcard later that day that would be great so we can update vendor settings.

Erin (Travel): Will check and reply here. If vendor accepted later we'll follow up to close the loop.

Tom (Finance): Approved and queued for processing. Reimbursement method on file = payroll.

Sophie: Appreciated, closing thread. :)
